title.zh: 机制区别：材料怎样被去掉

subtitle.zh: 液相反应、活性物种与离子作用。
subtitle.en: Liquid-phase reactions, reactive species and ion action

body.zh: 核心判断；湿法以液相化学反应去除材料；常见RIE依靠化学反应与离子作用协同。；干法还包含气相化学刻蚀、离子束刻蚀等不同机制。
body.en: Core assessment Wet etching removes material through liquid-phase chemistry; typical RIE combines chemical reactions and ion action Dry etching also includes gas-phase chemical etching, ion-beam etching and other mechanisms

body.zh: 流程位置；接收目标膜层及掩膜/暴露区域，完成材料去除，交给后清洗和量测。
body.en: Position in the flow Receive the target film and mask/exposed regions, remove material, then pass to post-clean and metrology

body.zh: 湿法刻蚀（液相化学反应）；反应物在液相中与表面发生化学反应，生成可溶性产物。；刻蚀液；（化学反应物）；可溶性产物；随液流带走；掩膜；Si；各向异性湿法示例；（晶向选择性，侧壁向内倾斜）
body.en: Wet etching (liquid-phase chemical reaction) Reactants chemically react with the surface in liquid to form soluble products Etchant (chemical reactant) Soluble products carried away by liquid flow Mask Si Example of anisotropic wet etching (crystallographic selectivity; inward-sloping sidewalls)

body.zh: 反应离子刻蚀（RIE，反应性干法）；气相活性物种发生化学反应，离子提供能量辅助去除。；中性活性物种；正离子；（化学反应）；（提供能量）；掩膜；挥发性产物；被抽气带走；Si；各向异性干法示例；（化学反应＋离子作用）
body.en: Reactive ion etching (RIE, reactive dry etching) Reactive gas species react chemically while ions supply energy to assist removal Neutral reactive species Positive ions (chemical reaction) (energy supply) Mask Volatile products removed by pumping Si Example of anisotropic dry etching (chemical reaction + ion action)

body.zh: 过程链；该链主要描述湿法与；反应性干法；纯物理；溅射以动量传递去除；材料。
body.en: Process chain This chain mainly describes wet and reactive dry etching; pure physical sputtering removes material through momentum transfer
5 Products are carried away by liquid flow or pumping

body.zh: 关键控制；• 反应物供给；• 表面温度；产物排出；• RIE另需控制离子能量
body.en: Key controls • Reactant supply • Surface temperature Product removal • RIE also requires ion-energy control

body.zh: 耦合与失效；加强离子作用可能促进；去除，也可能增加掩膜；损耗和表面损伤；供给；不足或产物排出不畅可；能造成残留与局部刻蚀；不足。
body.en: Coupling and failure Stronger ion action can promote removal but may also increase mask loss and surface damage; insufficient supply or poor product evacuation may cause residue and local underetch

body.zh: 量测反馈；用膜厚差或台阶深度；估算速率，结合缺陷检；查判断是否去净，支持；复核供给、温控与表面；状态。
body.en: Metrology feedback Estimate rate from film-thickness change or step depth, and inspect defects to determine whether removal is complete; use this to review supply, temperature control and surface condition

body.zh: 下游影响与边界；表面残留会影响后续成；膜、接触或附着；干法；不能全部解释为“靠离；子撞击”。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries Surface residue affects subsequent film growth, contacts or adhesion; dry etching cannot always be explained as ion bombardment alone
